name: Yunnan Pu'er tea
where: Kangle Tea Market, official brand shops
about: Pu'er is a fermented tea from Yunnan, sold as compressed cakes. Kunming is the main trading hub for it.
tip: Choose raw (sheng) or ripe (shu) tea by taste. Skip expensive antique teas, which are often hard to verify.

name: Rose flower cake
where: Jia Hua Bakery (嘉华鲜花饼) official shop
about: A pastry filled with edible Yunnan rose petals. It is a classic Kunming treat that locals often give as gifts.
tip: Check the expiry date before you buy, since these pastries do not keep long.

name: Dried mushrooms
about: Yunnan is famous for its wild mushrooms, and Dounan is one of the best-known markets for them.
tip: Matsutake is very expensive, so compare prices before buying the premium varieties.
